facts.clause: Active: Neeko becomes invisible for […] seconds and projects a clone that lasts […] seconds.
Neeko can activate to send a clone in a direction and recast to change the direction of the clone.
Neeko slings a tangle that damages and roots everything it passes through.
Upon landing, nearby enemies are damaged and stunned.
After a short preparation, Neeko leaps into the air, knocking up all nearby enemies.
